title: The One With The Blackout
line: Oh, alright. The weirdest place would have to be... (sigh)... oh, the foot of the bed.

title: The One With the Two Parties
line: My parents happened. All they had to do was sit in the same stadium, smile proudly, and not talk about the divorce. But nooo, they got into a huge fight in the middle of the commencement address. Bishop Tutu actually had to stop and shush them. But you know what, you know what the good news is? I get to serve coffee for the next 8 hours.

title: The One With The Nap Partners
line: Look Monica, getting cold feet is very common. You know, it's-it's just because of all the anticipation and you just have to remember that you love Chandler. And also, I ran out on a wedding. You don't get to keep the gifts.

title: The One With The Halloween Party
line: No, I also had to go to a couple houses with him as his girlfriend. Oh, I am just awful with children!

title: The One Where Chandler Can't Cry
line: Jill this is not about me being jealous of you! This is about you being a brat! Wanting what you can't have!

title: The One With the East German Laundry Detergent
line: Ok, I know this is gonna sound really stupid, but I feel that if I can do this, you know, if I can actually do my own laundry, there isn't anything I can't do.

title: Friends TV Show The One With The Blind Date
line: (awkward chuckle) Now, come on. Come on, Steve. There must be something that you like about yourself.

title: The One With The Proposal, Parts 1 and 2
line: Well, you know what? Actually, I was about to bid on this lovely trip to Paris.

title: The One With Chandler and Monica's Wedding, Parts 1 and 2
line: I know. I know. Oh God. (Looking around) There's no tissue! Can you grab me some toilet paper?

title: The One With Joey's Porsche
line: When?! After the birth of our first secret child?! (To All) Ross didn't get the annulment; we are still married.

title: The One With The Rumor
line: (entering carrying a book) Okay! Okay! Listen to what Sean McMahon wrote in my yearbook senior year, "Dear Rach, you're such a good person." Not girl! Person!

title: The One Where Phoebe Runs
line: Yeah, it'll be fun. We'll run in the park. It'll be like our first you know roommate bonding thing.

title: The One With The Routine
line: Well, that's a lot better than Ross trying to kiss me in High School, and saying that he did it because he needed chapstick.

title: The One Hundredth
line: Honey, you know I just gotta tell you, I think this is such a terrific thing you're having these babies for Frank and Alice.

title: The One Where Joey Dates Rachel
line: Emmm. Now, instead of the vegetables, is there anyway I can substitute the three-pound lobster?

title: The One With the East German Laundry Detergent
line: Well, not myself, but I know other people that have. Ok, you caught me. I'm a laundry virgin.

title: The One With The Race Car Bed
line: What? What? He's interested in you. He-he likes your hair, he just wants to know how you got here.

title: The One Where the Monkey Gets Away
line: Ross, I said I'm sorry like a million times. What do you want me to do? You want me to break my foot too? Okay, I'm gonna break my foot, right here. (Kicks the sign) Ow!! Oh! Oh my God, oh my God! There, are you happy now?!

title: The One With the Evil Orthodontist
line: Right,.. well,.. we never actually got to that... Oh, it was just so nice to see him again, you know? It was comfortable, it was familiar... it was just nice!

title: The One Where Old Yeller Dies
line: I don't know, you tell me. One minute I'm holding Ben like a football, the next thing I know, I've got two kids, I'm living in Scarsdale complaining about the taxes.

title: The One With The Halloween Party
line: Yeah I know, but one of them just said that she loved me so I just gave her everything.

title: The One With Rachel's New Dress
line: That sounds like a plan. Umm, is there a place I can go freshen up?

title: Friends TV Show The One At The Fertility Clinic
line: Oh. Um, hi. I, uh, I have a massage appointment under Rachel Green. And here is my gift certificate.

title: The One With The Blackout
line: I just never had a relationship with that kind of passion, you know, where you have to have somebody right there, in the middle of a theme park.

title: The One With Ross's Teeth
line: I did but she doesn't think anyone would be stupid enough to confuse Kenny the copy guy with Ralph Lauren.

title: The One Where Underdog Gets Away
line: I loved the moment when you first saw the giant dog shadow all over the park.

title: The One Where Rachel Smokes
line: Oh no, my dad's a doctor and he would always tell me just horror stories...(stops and tries to change directions)...about ghosts and goblins who totally supported the princess's right to smoke.

title: The One Where Eddie Won't Go
line: Ok, let me take these cakes back 'cause they're gonna take that out of my paycheck.

title: The One With Ross' New Girlfriend
line: I am? Oh, look at that, yes I am. Enough about me, enough about me, Mr. Back from the Orient. Come on. I wanna hear everything! Everything. (Looks at Julie)

title: The One That Could Have Been, Parts 1 and 2
line: Me? I'm great! I'm fine! I'm sooo good!! But, you know who's not great?! Men! You're a man right Ross?!

title: The One With All The Wedding Dresses
line: Yeah, maybe, but I don't think I even care. I don't think he's the one I'm sad about. You know, I know that I said that I am totally okay with Ross getting married, but as it turns out, I don't think I'm handling it all that well.

title: The One With Rachel's Crush
line: You know what, I'm gonna do that, I'm gonna call him up, and I'm gonna ask him out. I can do that. Ask him out. (Practicing) How you doin'? (Calls him) Hi! Joshua? It's Rachel Green from Bloomingdale's. (Listens) Yeah, umm, I was wondering if you umm, if you umm, left your wallet at the store today? Well, we found a wallet, and we...(Listens) the license? Well, that is a good idea! Uh, well, let's see here this says this license belongs to a uh, uh, belongs to a mister uh, Pheebs, and umm, yeah, so sorry to bother you at home. I'll see you tomorrow. Bye. (Hangs up) (to Phoebe) You've done that a thousand times?

title: The One With The Fake Monica
line: Oh God, oh. Great, Monica, you know what, you could've called, I have been up here, I've been worried...

title: The One With The Inappropriate Sister
line: Well, I met Danny's sister yesterday, and uh that was actually the girl on the subway.

title: The One Where Paul's The Man
line: Yeah hon, it can't hurt to put your name down! I mean in if two years if you're not engaged you just don't use it.

title: Friends TV Show The One Where Ross Is Fine
line: Uh-huh. Okay. Yeah, you know, Joey, I don't think he's ever gonna be okay with this.

title: The One With Joey's New Girlfriend
line: You know, the world would be such a better place if that actually was all you were gonna say.

title: The One Where the Monkey Gets Away
line: (On the phone) Okay, he's a, he's a black capuchin monkey with a white face... (Enter Ross) ...with, with Russian dressing and, and pickles on the side. Okay. Thanks.

title: The One With The Vows
line: Joey, look. Just look at it this way. The sooner Phoebe breaks Chandler, the sooner this is all over and out in the open.

title: The One Where Rachel Smokes
line: Well you know if you, if you started smoking again you could've at least told me! Come on, give me one of those! What are we talking about?

title: The One With Monica's Boots
line: Hey, now wait a minute! I get when you told people at first that you wanted to be an actor they laughed at you! Now come on Bobby, why don't you tell us a little bit about your band?

title: The One Where Joey Dates Rachel
line: Oh man! This is so great! I actually feel like I'm going on a real date! Although, I have a hint of morning sickness, and I'm wearing underwear that goes up to about...(She snaps the waistband on her underwear that is just slightly below her breasts)...there.

title: The One With Ross' Step Forward
line: So, you had the conversation you didn't wanna have, and you made the gesture you didn't wanna make.

title: The One With The Girl From Poughkeepsie
line: You told this guy that I was looking for a fling?! You don't tell the guy that!

title: The One With The Yeti
line: Hi! Sorry to bother you, but I don't think we can accept your acceptance of our apology, it just doesn't really seem like you mean it.

title: The One With All The Jealousy
line: Oh no, no-no-no, that's not, not, not, what he is doing. He's just, he's just really romantic.

title: The One With The Apothecary Table
line: No! No! No! No it's not! No it's not! Come on! Phoebe, ours is totally different! I mean we don't have the... (Looks desperately for something different.) We don't have the...that lamp! And-and that screen is you know, on the other side.

title: The One With The Vows
line: I can not believe he would do that to Mon.... Wha.... (She stops suddenly and slowly turns to point at Joey. Joey is avoiding her eyes.) Joey, do they know that we know?

title: The One With The Engagement Picture
line: (Pretending to be really mad and annoyed) Tag is not here! My God! Do you people have nothing better to do than to traipse into my office and gawk at my assistant?

title: The One With The Stripper
line: Ross I'm so sorry. Okay. I-I will promise I will straighten this out with him tomorrow in person, or via e-mail.

title: The One With The Soap Opera Party
line: And-and he didn't want you guys to know about it but I came over here to tell you!!

title: The One Where They're Up All Night
line: Or maybe you would see me looking embarrassed because you are talking on the phone with your crotch!

title: The One With The Thanksgiving Flashbacks
line: Yeah, you know what we should all do? We should play that game where everyone says one thing that they're thankful for.

title: The One With George Stephanopoulos
line: (miserably) No. No, no. That's not what we ordered. We ordered a fat-free crust with extra cheese.

title: The One With Rachel's Assistant
line: Yes, I know that. I know that. And I know that hiring him was probably not the smartest thing that I've ever done. But I'm telling you, from this moment on I swear this is strictly professional. (There's a knock on the door.) Yes?

title: The One With The Flashback
line: Oh, I don't know. Well maybe it's just the idea of Barry for the rest of my life. I don't know I think I feel like I need to have one last fling, you know, just to sorta get it out of my system. (Chandler is listening in very intensely)

title: The One With The Stripper
line: I mean he was possessive, he was jealous, he could never just let the little things go!

title: The One With The Thanksgiving Flashbacks
line: (entering) Oh-ho, my God! That was so awesome! You totally got him back for calling you fat! He was just drooling all over you. That must've felt so great!

title: The One Where Ross Finds Out
line: No! Ah! It's too late for that man. I have just screwed this all up. I just want to get over him. gosh, why can't I do that? Michael: Oy. Look, I've been through a divorce, trust me you're gonna be fine. You just can't see it now because you haven't had any closure. Rachel: Yeah! Closure. That's what it is, that's what I need. God, you're brilliant! Why didn't I think of that? How do I get that? Michael: Well, you know, there's no one way really, it's just, you know, whatever it takes so that you can finally say to him, "I'm over you." Rachel: Closure, that's what it is. Closure. [she looks around the restaurant, spotting a guy with a cellular phone] Hello, excuse me. Excuse me, hel. . . woo [she almost falls out of her chair] GUY: Hang on. Rachel: Hello, excuse me. GUY: What. Rachel: Hi, I'm sorry, I need to borrow your phone for just one minute. GUY: I'm talkin'! Rachel: I can see that. I... just one phone call, I'll be very quick, I'll even pay for it myself. [man is still reluctant] OK, you're bein' a little weird about your phone. GUY: Alright, fine. [on the phone] I'll call you back. [hands the phone to her] Rachel: Thank you. (To Michael in a drunk way) I am so good with people. OK. [dials] Machine. Just waiting for the beep. Michael: Good. RACHEL: [on phone] Ross, hi, it's Rachel. I'm just calling to say that um, everything's fine and I'm really happy for you and your cat who, by the way, I think you should name Michael:. And, you know, ya see there I'm thinking of names so obviously, I am over you. I am over you and that, my friend, is what they call closure. [hangs up and tosses phone in the ice bucket]

title: Friends TV Show The One With Christmas In Tulsa
line: (Reading from a tag that's attached to the shoe) "Dear losers, do you really think I'd hide presents under the couch? P.S. Chandler, I knew they'd break you."
